mapper.select: SELECT a.id::text AS account_id,a.credential_version,a.permissions FROM iam_session_grant g JOIN iam_account a ON a.id=g.account_id WHERE g.token_digest=#{digest} AND NOT g.revoked AND g.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND a.enabled AND a.credential_version=g.credential_version
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_session_grant SET revoked=true WHERE token_digest=#{digest}
